lede: The biggest item on the civic calendar this week is the Telluride Ecology Commission taking up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers by 2028 and all other combustion lawn equipment by 2030 — a real code change, not just a conversation. Meanwhile, the TMVOA kicks off its three-meeting 2027 budget cycle with a first look at the numbers and a completed 2025 audit, and Mountain Village's Design Review Board has a quasi-judicial easement encroachment hearing on the docket. On the community side, the week rounds out with Art Walk Friday and the library's Adult Spelling Bee.

notable.stake: Draft ordinance would ban gas-powered lawn equipment in town by 2030.
